outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: The Cockatiel (Nymphicus hollandicus) is a diminutive cockatoo endemic to Australia and prized as a household pet.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: The cockatiel's scientific name Nymphicus hollandicus reflects the experience of one of the earliest groups of Europeans to see cockatiels in their native habitat.
